name: Rp Custom Woodworking LLC
old_description: We worked with Carson to build a raised deck in our backyard. This was outside the scope of his normal work, but easily within his skill set. In fact, I'm convinced that if it's anything to do with wood he will figure it out and do high quality work! He was very easy to work with - quick to respond to texts and emails, always ready to adjust and problem-solve as new challenges arose (as they did!). He has great relationships with wood sourcers, and will knows how to pick out high quality product. We are incredibly happy with our new cedar deck and highly recommend Carson for any project you can imagine.
about:
Rp Custom Woodworking LLC operates from Salt Lake City, Utah. The shop is run by Carson, who works directly with clients on custom wood projects. No founding year or ownership structure is publicly disclosed.

The company provides custom woodworking services including cabinetry, furniture making, and table and desk fabrication. Projects range from residential pieces such as a cedar raised deck to commercial installations like restaurant service station cabinets. Carson sources wood through established supplier relationships and handles each build from design through completion.

Clients include homeowners seeking custom decks and furniture, as well as commercial businesses in the restaurant sector. The shop has delivered work for a restaurant called Bambara, producing service station cabinets, demonstrating capacity for both residential and light commercial projects.

Customer feedback highlights Carson’s responsiveness, problem-solving approach, and ability to source high-quality lumber. The business emphasizes direct collaboration and adaptability as projects evolve, with a reputation for high-quality workmanship on custom builds.
